request.prompt: Animate this 3D anime teacher character leading a repeat-after-me drill in a Korean classroom. COMPOSITION: The teacher stands IN FRONT OF a large green chalkboard, positioned on the RIGHT SIDE of the frame (30-35% width). The clean chalkboard is visible on the LEFT (65-70%). The teacher is clearly BETWEEN the camera and the chalkboard. Medium shot, waist-up, eye-level. MOTION: The teacher faces the camera directly with a warm encouraging smile. She makes a slow rhythmic teaching gesture — gently moving her right hand in a follow-along beat pattern as if conducting a pronunciation drill. Her mouth opens and closes naturally as if speaking each word slowly. Between words she pauses and nods encouragingly. Patient supportive expression throughout, occasional gentle head tilts. LIGHTING: Calm soft classroom lighting. FORMAT: Horizontal 16:9. IMPORTANT: Do NOT generate any text, letters, word cards, subtitles, logos, or watermarks.
